motion.name: Ink
motion.purpose: No animation on the ink path.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Implemented shared primary action, including focus, press, disabled and touch states.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:34px;padding:8px 12px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:var(--accent,#385775);color:var(--panel,#fff);font:500 13px var(--ui-font,'DM Sans Variable',sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--motion,180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)),color var(--motion,180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1))}.ds-primary:hover:enabled{background:var(--accent-strong,#2d4863);}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#385775);outline-offset:3px}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.38;cursor:default}.ds-primary:active:enabled{transform:translateY(1px)}@media(pointer:coarse){.ds-primary{min-width:44px;min-height:44px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition-duration:.01ms}}:host-context([data-theme='dark']) .ds-primary{color:#192633}

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Implemented shared secondary action, including focus, press, disabled and touch states.
components.css: .ds-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:34px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line,#e0e4ea);border-radius:6px;background:var(--panel,#fff);color:var(--text,#253044);font:500 13px var(--ui-font,'DM Sans Variable',sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--motion,180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)),color var(--motion,180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1))}.ds-secondary:hover:enabled{background:var(--surface,#f1f3f6);}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#385775);outline-offset:3px}.ds-secondary:disabled{opacity:.38;cursor:default}.ds-secondary:active:enabled{transform:translateY(1px)}@media(pointer:coarse){.ds-secondary{min-width:44px;min-height:44px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary{transition-duration:.01ms}}

components.name: Quiet action
components.description: Implemented shared quiet action, including focus, press, disabled and touch states.
components.css: .ds-quiet{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:34px;padding:8px 12px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#59657a);font:500 13px var(--ui-font,'DM Sans Variable',sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--motion,180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)),color var(--motion,180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1))}.ds-quiet:hover:enabled{background:var(--hover,#e7ebf0);color:var(--text,#253044);}.ds-quiet:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#385775);outline-offset:3px}.ds-quiet:disabled{opacity:.38;cursor:default}.ds-quiet:active:enabled{transform:translateY(1px)}@media(pointer:coarse){.ds-quiet{min-width:44px;min-height:44px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-quiet{transition-duration:.01ms}}

components.name: Text field
components.description: Representative titled field using the implemented shared input styling.
components.css: .ds-label{display:grid;gap:8px;color:var(--text,#253044);font:500 13px var(--ui-font,'DM Sans Variable',sans-serif)}.ds-field{width:100%;min-height:40px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line,#e0e4ea);border-radius:6px;background:var(--surface,#f1f3f6);color:var(--text,#253044);caret-color:var(--accent,#385775);font:14px var(--ui-font,'DM Sans Variable',sans-serif)}.ds-field::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#59657a)}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#385775);outline-offset:3px}.ds-field:disabled{opacity:.38;cursor:default}.ds-field:active:enabled{transform:translateY(1px)}@media(pointer:coarse){.ds-field{min-width:44px;min-height:44px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-field{transition-duration:.01ms}}

components.name: Workspace navigation
components.description: Selected destination from the actual workspace navigation.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;text-align:left;padding:10px 12px;width:100%;border:0;border-radius:6px;font:13px var(--ui-font,'DM Sans Variable',sans-serif);color:var(--muted,#59657a);background:transparent;min-height:39px;cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--motion,180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)),color var(--motion,180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1))}.ds-nav:hover{background:var(--hover,#e7ebf0);color:var(--text,#253044)}.ds-nav[aria-current=page]{background:var(--selected,#e0e8f1);color:var(--accent,#385775);font-weight:550}.ds-nav:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#385775);outline-offset:3px}.ds-nav:disabled{opacity:.38;cursor:default}.ds-nav:active:enabled{transform:translateY(1px)}@media(pointer:coarse){.ds-nav{min-width:44px;min-height:44px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav{transition-duration:.01ms}}

components.name: Markdown mode
components.description: Selected Reading control within the implemented compact mode group.

components.name: Document preview
components.description: Representative excerpt of the labeled editable Oscillations & waves example, using the actual library preview hierarchy.
components.css: .ds-document{display:block;width:100%;max-width:270px;padding:0;border:0;text-align:left;background:transparent;color:var(--text,#253044);font:14px var(--ui-font,'DM Sans Variable',sans-serif);cursor:pointer}.ds-preview{display:block;height:172px;background:var(--surface,#f1f3f6);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;transition:box-shadow var(--motion,180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)),transform var(--motion,180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1))}.ds-document:hover .ds-preview{box-shadow:0 5px 16px #25354d18;transform:translateY(-2px)}.ds-paper{display:block;margin:14px 17px 0;padding:17px;min-height:230px;background:var(--panel,#fff);border-radius:2px;box-shadow:0 2px 9px #25354d0c}.ds-mini{font:7px/1.5 var(--reading-font,'Source Serif 4',Georgia,serif);color:var(--muted,#59657a)}.ds-mini>strong{display:block;font:600 13px/1.25 var(--ui-font,'DM Sans Variable',sans-serif);margin:0 0 9px;color:var(--text,#253044)}.ds-mini p{margin:0 0 7px;line-height:1.6}.ds-mini blockquote{margin:8px 0;padding:4px 7px;background:var(--surface,#f1f3f6)}.ds-document-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin-top:13px;font-size:12px}.ds-document-title strong{font-weight:550;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-document-title svg{color:var(--muted,#59657a);flex-shrink:0}.ds-document-meta{display:block;margin-top:6px;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted,#59657a);padding-left:22px}.ds-document:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#385775);outline-offset:3px}.ds-document:disabled{opacity:.38;cursor:default}.ds-document:active:enabled{transform:translateY(1px)}@media(pointer:coarse){.ds-document{min-width:44px;min-height:44px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-document{transition-duration:.01ms}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-preview{transition-duration:.01ms}}

narrative.overview:
Slate opens a quiet course library into a generous page, with context in reach. Cool neutrals and slate-blue ink give the workspace a calm, local character.

The completed, code-led layout centers physical pages and compact floating tools. Paper grids are functional notebook templates.
keyCharacteristics: Cool-neutral surfaces and slate-blue interaction ink.
Self-hosted DM Sans and Source Serif 4.
Pages with square corners, quiet separators and compact floating tools.
Adaptive context around a stable reading column.

rules.name: Ink marks action
rules.body: Use the primary family for actions, selected tools and focus. Success and danger communicate status.

rules.name: Theme the workspace, preserve the paper
rules.body: Use neutral surfaces to separate canvas, rail, panels and controls. Page paper stays independent of the UI theme. Dark faint text shares dark-muted-ink; dark primary actions use dark-primary-ink.

rules.name: Separate navigation from reading
rules.body: Use DM Sans for the interface and prose headings, Source Serif 4 for reading, and genuine monospace for source and code. Reading size responds to preference.

rules.name: Keep context within reach
rules.body: — The first viewport pairs a rail and slim bar with a title, recent previews, and folder and document rows. The top bar owns note creation. Context yields before the rail; phone destinations move into a drawer and bottom navigation. Reading-column width, margins, and placement are saved user preferences shared by all Markdown modes; physical-page dimensions are source coordinates that scale to the viewport.

rules.name: Lift transient tools
rules.body: Keep panels and previews quietly bordered. Use restrained shadows for floating menus and the compact ink toolbar.

rules.name: Square paper, rounded controls
rules.body: Keep physical pages square-cornered; use the observed control, preview, menu and ink-toolbar radii for their respective surfaces.

rules.name: Make states visible
rules.body: Use filled primary, bordered secondary and muted quiet actions. Action and field heights are minimums; coarse-pointer controls reach 44px square. Preserve focus and disabled states.

rules.name: Keep motion out of ink
rules.body: Use short interface easing, honor reduced motion, and keep ink sampling and rendering animation-free.

dos: Use real document content in previews.
Keep paper grids tied to functional templates.
donts: Apply the workspace theme to page paper.
Turn document-type metadata into a marketing kicker.
